_doc: expect: tool name, a list of acceptable tools, or null (no Papr tool should fire; a distractor or no tool is fine). Prompts are phrased the way users actually ask and are self-contained (the eval is single-turn). We score the FIRST tool call, so the first step of a correct flow counts (e.g. looking up the meeting before prepping it).
